facts.value: The academic program may or may not require supplemental documents such as letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, resume, portfolio or test scores (GRE, GMAT, MAT).
The application requires your cumulative undergraduate GPA.
Junior-senior GPA refers to the last two years or 60 semester credit hours of your undergraduate work.
You will not receive an application fee refund if your application is not complete by the deadline.
Application deadlines are set and managed by individual degree programs. Visit the program website to review the deadlines for your proposed admission term.
For general application advice, join the next Graduate Information Session and Application Advice webinar.
To discuss deadlines and exceptions, contact the academic program office offering the program.
You can usually refer to your transcript to see the GPA awarded by your university.
ASU will only email individuals listed on a submitted admission application.
You have access to resend the email to your recommender every seven days through My ASU by clicking on the Manage Recommenders link.
If your recommender does not seem to be receiving the emails, please have them check their email spam or junk folder.
